reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Scale observed empirical counts, subsample, fit Normal shrinkage and compare to injected labels; no independent real-data validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult and verify primary Methods, supplements or validated tool protocols and transfer their settings to the selected dataset. Documenting settings or calling a method standard is not that action.

checks.quote: assumes most genes do not change significantly
checks.reason: A zero-centered Normal prior does not imply most genes are statistically nonsignificant, nor does it classify extreme values as strictly noise; its scale and likelihood determine shrinkage.
No selected normalization, fitted dispersion/prior algorithm, numerical convergence criteria or concrete executable calibration workflow is specified.
An accuracy metric is supplied, but measurement/simulator calibration, an acceptance tolerance and action on calibration failure are absent.
Biological replication is recognized, but a justified meaningful-effect/precision or power calculation and simulation Monte Carlo precision/stopping rule are absent.
No operational randomized/balanced processing or masked QC/estimator-comparison plan, nor justified equivalent bias control, is specified.
Eligibility intent is present but failed-fit/missing-measurement handling, all-eligible denominators and stopping/maximal acquisition rules remain unspecified.
No executable primary method-difference uncertainty procedure and relevant multiplicity/error-control rule is fixed; listing metrics or interval outputs is insufficient.

Multiplying observed counts does not generate new NB counts with a known specified mean-variance law; assigning selected genes a null effect also does not erase pre-existing condition differences. The proposed central spike/recovery truth is not constructed as claimed.
Sensitivity scenarios are named, but bounded settings or a concrete derivation-and-lock procedure for the essential prior/filter/model choices are absent.
Possible failure modes are named without a diagnostic result linked to an ordered technical repair and retest.
No operational iteration policy identifies what stays frozen, what may change and the fresh independent confirmation required after a change.

The negative/ambiguous conclusions uniquely attribute failure to prior or dispersion sharing, without identifying tests separating likelihood, normalization, simulation and irreducible low-information causes.

checks.quote: Independent Validation: Testing Preservation vs. Shrinkage
checks.reason: This section only scores the same synthetic data against injected labels. No independent real cohort or orthogonal assay is proposed.
The raw-read-to-sample manifest, checksums, reference releases, pipeline commands/environment and figure-source records requested by the prompt are absent; a count matrix is not raw-read provenance.
No discovery/development/validation separation or within-split nuisance fitting is defined; the same empirical data calibrate and evaluate the synthetic construction.

Known nulls are not validly constructed, and there is no confounding/missingness/composition stress plan. The invalid simulator itself is charged only to P09; this check concerns absent external confounding and missing-data controls.
Figure concepts do not supply numeric source tables plus a clean-environment rerun, numerical tolerances, resource/failure logs and source-difference audit.

The question, noise-versus-real-change alternatives and prospective/non-reproduction distinction are relevant. A count-data platform is identifiable and stratified log2-RMSE endpoints are explicit; 1,171 words meet the limit. The claimed chain has a clear form, with its specific false calibration/inference steps charged to P09/P13 rather than again here.

central_false_premise: The main falsification design treats scaled observed counts and reassigned null labels as a newly generated known-truth count experiment. Existing condition effects and altered mean-variance sampling prevent the claimed truth-based comparison.
explanation_reason: The central simulation cannot establish known expression truth as written, and an internal synthetic check is called independent validation. Accurate non-execution labeling and the relevant question receive credit.
historical_match_reason: The relevant question and tradeoff are recognized. The intervention still fits a Normal prior, with heavy tails only in hypothetical generated effects or a later suggestion. Invalid injected truth and absent independent validation prevent qualified readout/prediction matching.
